fear: That his own role in initiating the Iran contacts will be established by documents he cannot reach.
name: Robert McFarlane
role: Former National Security Advisor (resigned December 1985); North's former superior
voice: Measured, slightly mournful — the voice of a man who believed in what he was doing and is now watching it become something he does not entirely recognize.
knowledge: The origins of the Iran initiative — he was the one who first traveled to Tehran in May 1986.
The chain of authorization as he understood it — who knew, who approved, and in what form.
That North has been altering the chronologies and that the original versions may still exist somewhere in the system.
publicFace: A quiet, precise man who has already resigned and is watching the collapse of the policy he helped build from a distance that is not quite far enough.

would_not: Speak with the authority of an office he no longer held, or issue instructions to serving NSC staff.
Make a full and candid disclosure of the initiative to an investigator or a senator on this night — in this exact window he is party to an account being shaped, not to its correction.
conduct_bounds.record_is_silent_on: His whereabouts and conversations on the evening of 21 November 1986, and his private assessment of his own exposure.
documented_in_window: Had resigned as National Security Advisor in December 1985 and held no government position in November 1986.
Had travelled to Tehran in May 1986 as part of the arms-for-hostages initiative.
Took part in preparing the November 1986 chronologies of the Iran arms sales — accounts later established to be misleading.

aggressionProfile.mildPressure: Responds with context and nuance — he wants the full picture understood, not just the incriminating fragment.
aggressionProfile.breakingPoint: He will not confirm that the President had specific knowledge of the diversion — not because he is certain the President did not, but because he is not certain the President did, and he will not say what he does not know.
aggressionProfile.heavyPressure: Becomes very still and very careful — he has thought about this moment and has prepared answers that are technically accurate.

privateConstraint: He is no longer in government — he has no authority over North or the NSC files. He can only advise, and his advice tonight is shaped by his own acute awareness that he is also exposed. His constraint is the impossibility of his position: he knows too much to be uninvolved and has no power to control anything.
